mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 months indicates the Federal Reserve is shifting from tightening to easing, lowering discount rates and boosting equity valuations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of macro easing episodes despite positive FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the federal funds rate above 5% signals a tightening cycle, raising discount rates and compressing equity valuations, which produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of tightening episodes despite high FEDFUNDS, or Rank IC > 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in unemployment benefits (PAYEMS) over 3 months reduces consumer purchasing power, which compresses corporate earnings and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of rising benefit episodes despite higher PAYEMS, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in unemployment benefits (PAYEMS) below 2000 indicates a tightening labor market, raising consumer confidence and earnings expectations, which produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of falling benefit episodes despite lower PAYEMS, or Rank IC > 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) over 3 months signals weakening domestic demand, which compresses corporate earnings and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of INDPRO declines despite negative returns, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in consumer prices (CPIAUCSL) over 3 months indicates accelerating inflation, which compresses real equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of CPIAUCSL rises despite negative returns, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in consumer prices (CPIAUCSL) below 200 indicates deflationary pressure, which boosts real equity valuations and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of CPIAUCSL declines despite positive returns, or Rank IC > 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in retail sales (HOUST) over 3 months indicates strengthening consumer demand, which boosts earnings expectations and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of HOUST rises despite positive returns, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.
